content.text: {"issuing_body":"文化審議会著作権分科会法制度小委員会 (Subcommittee on Legal Systems, Copyright Division, Council for Cultural Affairs, Agency for Cultural Affairs, Japan)","document_type":"regulatory_guidance","binding_strength":"regulatory_guidance","publication_date":"2024-03-15","effective_date":null,"covered_actors":["AI開発事業者 (AI developers)","AIサービス提供事業者 (AI service providers)","AI利用者 (AI users)","クリエイター・実演家等の権利者 (creators, performers, and other rights holders)"],"covered_application_domains":["general_purpose_models"],"prohibited_practices":[],"enforcement_authorities":["文化庁 (Agency for Cultural Affairs)"],"compliance_deadlines":[],"penalties_summary":null,"implementation_notes":"Document explicitly states it has no legal binding force ('本考え方自体が法的な拘束力を有するものではない'). It is interpretive guidance on how existing Japanese copyright law applies to generative AI, covering training/learning stage and generation/use stage. The document notes it may be revised as case law, technology, and international developments evolve. It references Article 30-4 (non-enjoyment-purpose use) and Article 47-5 of the Copyright Act as relevant rights-limitation provisions. No prohibited practices are formally established; the document clarifies existing law rather than imposing new rules.","confidence":0.92}
